root.claim: A simultaneous normalized butterfly layer $H_0^{\otimes D}$ on one common bit position of each of $D\le d$ consecutive $K$-bit address chunks of polynomial records of precision $p$ runs in $O(Vd^{\lambda'})$ time for a fixed $\lambda'<1$, with one final truncation of error below $\sqrt2\,2^{-p}$.
root.method: Evaluate the layer exactly through the complex phase network, whose edge changes become kernels on groups of $e/m$ axes (smaller layers on streams of volume $V/W_{\rm c}$), implement its binary basis changes by packed selected-bit addition, and truncate once at the end.

motivation.text: Separate butterfly factors would need D whole-array passes, so all D are done in one recursive layer.

adds.name: complex wire count

adds.meaning: The sum of the ranks of the edge changes of the phase network, which is the number of child layers one run makes.
